title: SharedTable
tagline: a social dining application with web3 incentives through gamification
description: This project uses AI algorithm to enable easy and efficient social dining grouping. We use web3 incentive to reward users for dining out and social. We have designed a sophisticated gamification system with tokens and NFTs in mind. We want to enable users to truly own their data, credentials, rewards, and everything in the journey of using our app.
how_its_made: This project uses coinbase cdp wallet to enable a seamless wallet experience for users, enabling in-app transactions and nft avatar features. I use claude code and myNora.ai to help with the development. Claude code mainly helps me with frontend development. And myNora.ai mainly helps me on coinbase developer kit integration as it has indexed the knowledge specifically and it indeed works better than claude code.
